description: Check a Singapore home loan against the MAS TDSR limit (total monthly debt obligations must be at most 55% of gross monthly income) and find the maximum loan affordable. Variable and rental income count at 70%. Uses the stress-test interest rate (default 4% p.a.) and a tenure (default 25 years). From Propely (propely.sg), the owner-direct condo marketplace in Singapore. Indicative figures, not legal or financial advice.

carLoan.description: Monthly car loan repayment in Singapore dollars (SGD)

fixedIncome.description: Gross fixed monthly income (salary) in Singapore dollars (SGD)

interestRate.description: Interest rate in percent per year; MAS stress-test floor for private property is 4

loanAmount.description: Proposed home loan amount in Singapore dollars (SGD)

otherDebts.description: Other monthly debt repayments (credit cards, personal loans, other mortgages) in Singapore dollars (SGD)

rentalIncome.description: Monthly rental income; counted at 70% in Singapore dollars (SGD)

variableIncome.description: Monthly variable income (bonus, commission); counted at 70% in Singapore dollars (SGD)
